appDescription: ArriveOn provides MOCK restaurant recommendations near a fictional destination using adult and child counts. It does not make calls or reservations.

function.name: OPEN_ARRIVEON
function.description: Open the ArriveOn MOCK restaurant recommendation app without starting a search or making a call or reservation.

function.name: SEARCH_MOCK_RESTAURANTS
function.description: Set adult and child counts and start a MOCK restaurant recommendation search near the fictional destination displayed in ArriveOn.

adults.description: Whole number of adults, from 1 to 20.

children.description: Whole number of children, from 0 to 10.
